name: Panel Hub
title: Panel Hub
subtitle: Kerbal Controller Mk1 · Main enclosure
revisions: Supersedes V2.0; board V2.1 (U4 pin 1 to +5V); KC drawing frame
MPM3610 EN pull-up R3; 10 µF in, 22 µF out; 3.3 V bleeder R5

rows.label: Safe-switch terminal (U4) and INT_SAFE divider (R6, R4)
Power: 12 V to 5 V (U1) to 3.3 V (U2); 3.3 V bleeder R5 (10 kΩ)

stackup_note: JLCPCB JLC04161H-7628: dielectric materials and thicknesses as that stackup. Finished thickness 1.6 mm ±10 %.

layers.name: Top Layer
notes: Solder side of the through-hole connectors; the GND pour fills the open area.

layers.name: Bottom Layer
notes: Component side: every part mounts on this side, the SMT parts and the through-hole connectors.

fab_notes: 1. Material: FR-4, 1.6 mm, 4 layers, JLCPCB JLC04161H-7628 stackup (sheet 2 table).
2. Copper: 1 oz outer, 0.5 oz inner. Surface finish: lead-free HASL.
3. Solder mask green, silkscreen white, both sides. Vias tented.
4. Fabricate to IPC-6012 Class 2. Electrical test 100 %.
5. Dimensions in mm. Tolerances unless noted: outline ±0.2, finished holes ±0.08.
6. Fabricate from the Gerber and drill files of the same revision as this drawing.
7. Minimum trace width 0.20 mm. Smallest hole Ø0.30 (vias) on Ø0.61 pads: 0.15 mm annular ring.
8. The 4 plated mounting holes (M1–M4) are not connected to any net; keep them isolated on all layers.
9. No controlled impedance, slots, castellations, edge plating or gold fingers.
bom_notes: 1. INSTALLED BY: JLCPCB = fitted by the JLCPCB assemblers (SMT and through-hole) before delivery; After delivery = fitted by the builder.
2. PROCESS gives the assembly process and the side the part is on.
3. The panel's safe switch and arming switch wire to U4; they are part of the panel, not this board.
4. Substitutes need the approval of the design authority.
place_notes: 1. Every part is on the bottom side: the SMT parts U1, U2, C1–C5, R1–R6 and the through-hole connectors CN1, P1–P8 and U4 (soldered from the top). The top side has no parts.
2. The bottom view is drawn as seen holding the board bottom side up (flipped left to right), so the datum is at the top right.
3. Red dot = pin 1 of every part with more than two pins. These match the silkscreen marks.

4. U4 (silkscreen names): 1 SW_P = +5V, 2 SW_N = V_EN, 3 LED_P = V_EN, 4 LED_N = GND, 5 BTN_P = V_EN, 6 BTN_N = input to INT_SAFE through R6 / R4. Arming switch across SW_P / SW_N, its lamp across LED_P / LED_N, push-button across BTN_P / BTN_N.
5. Part centres, rotations and part numbers are in the placement table (last sheet), measured from the datum (top view).
